air_limit_kg.note: Small flights from Cape Town carry about 1,500 to 1,800 kg including people, personal and scientific cargo and emergency kits.

hazard_rule.text: Hazardous cargo (gases, chemicals, fuel, lithium-ion batteries) cannot go by air; arrange at Cape Town or ship it.

declaration_required.soil: Cleanliness / biosecurity declaration required before dispatch
declaration_required.source: Assumption for the prototype (Antarctic Treaty biosecurity practice)
